summary: Marine Products Corp filed an 8-K reporting stockholder approval of its acquisition by MasterCraft Boat Holdings through a two-step merger. The special meeting held May 12, 2026, voted to adopt the merger agreement. Terms include MasterCraft acquiring Marine Products via Merger Sub I and Merger Sub II, with Marine Products surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. The board recommends the deal. Closing awaits regulatory clearance and customary conditions. Monitor shareholder litigation or competing bids; risk-arb spread reflects deal certainty and timeline.
